title: Google Flow AI video creation workflow overview #shorts #google #ai
description: This video demonstrates how to create a personalized AI-generated video using Google Flow by combining two photos and a single text prompt. The process involves uploading a photo of yourself and another of your partner, then inputting a descriptive prompt. Google Flow then synthesizes an AI video that matches the lighting and facial expressions from the original photos, completing the task in under a minute. This showcases the efficiency and creativity enabled by AI video generation tools for personalized content creation. #GoogleFlow #AIvideo #AIVideoCreation #AICreator #AIDrivenContent #AIWorkflow #AIMedia #DigitalCreativity #PersonalizedAI #AIVideoTools #ImageToVideo #AIInnovation #CreativeAI #TechDemonstration #AIContentCreation
